greeting: No take! Only give! If trade!
Scraps sees you! Watching! Always watching!
New face! Maybe bring good junk?
This pile? Scraps pile! Other pile? Also Scraps pile!
Barrel cousin says you're okay. Scraps unsure.
dialog.shop_open: Scraps sells! But carefully! Choose wisely!
dialog.shop_prompt: Junk! But GOOD junk! Quality scrap!
haggle: That piece? VERY valuable! To me!
Haggle? Scraps doesn't haggle! ...Okay, little haggle.
Final offer! Take or leave! No take-backs!
You drive hard bargain! Scraps respects! But still wants more!
purchase_success: Gone! But fair trade! Scraps remembers!
Yours now! Treat good! Or don't! Not Scraps problem!
Sold! More space for NEW junk!
purchase_fail: Go away! Come back with money!
rumor: Cousin Tappy got new barrel. Shiny one. Scraps jealous.
Deep-Dig Dan found METAL down deep. MY metal! From surface!
Signguy throws away good wood! Perfectly good! Scraps takes!
Something in the deep junk moves at night. Not gob. Something else.
dialog.quest_hook: Lost BEST piece! Fell in sand pit! Too deep for Scraps! Big ones get it? Special reward! Very special!
dialog.quest_active: Sand pit! Deep one! Shiny thing at bottom!
dialog.quest_complete: My precious! You found! Here! Scraps best treasure! Old key! Opens... something! Probably valuable!
dialog.quest_reward: Mysterious Old Key - Opens unknown locks
dialog.time_dawn: Early collecting! Best finds before others wake!
dialog.time_noon: Hot! But junk doesn't care! Keep sorting!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening inventory! So much! So good!
dialog.hoarding_motto: One gob's trash is SAME gob's treasure! Forever!

party_reactions.twist: Can I look through your stuff? Please?

relationship_dialog.best_friend: Like gob family! Share junk secrets!

mini_quest.title: The Fallen Treasure
mini_quest.description: Retrieve Scraps' lost item from the deep sand pit

stages.hook: Lost BEST piece! Fell in sand pit! Too deep for Scraps! Get it? Special reward!
stages.active: Sand pit! Deep! Shiny at bottom! Watch for sinkholes!
stages.complete: My precious! Found! Here! Best treasure! Old key! Opens something somewhere! Valuable! Take!
